children: Sen returns to the retailer for a second stint after working at V-Mart Retail, with prior experience at Baazar Style Retail, INOX Leisure, Pantaloons and Aviva India
Ayan Sen has rejoined Shoppers Stop as Area Marketing Head, marking his second stint with the retailer. He previously worked with the company for six years, from 2014 to 2020.
Before returning to Shoppers Stop, Sen worked as Zonal Marketing Manager at V-Mart Retail for less than a year. Prior to that, he spent four years at Baazar Style Retail.

His expertise spans creative strategy, marketing budget management and market research. He also has experience in developing marketing calendars and executing above-the-line (ATL), below-the-line (BTL) and digital campaigns.
Over the course of his career, Sen has also worked with Baazar Retail, INOX Leisure, Pantaloons and Aviva India.
